description: This file contains unit tests for the DurableValue class, testing its basic operations, persistence, handling of null values, and support for complex types in a Orleans-based journaling system.

classes.name: DurableValueTests
classes.description: A test suite for the DurableValue class, verifying its correct behavior in various scenarios.

methods.name: DurableValue_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests setting and updating the DurableValue, verifying persistence via journaled state.

methods.name: DurableValue_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that a DurableValue persists and recovers its state across system restarts.

methods.name: DurableValue_NullValue_Test
methods.description: Checks handling of null values and their persistence in DurableValue.

methods.name: DurableValue_ComplexType_Test
methods.description: Tests serialization and mutation of complex objects stored within DurableValue.
